column1: # Reviewed semantic evidence for the OPEN startup entry and its adjacent word-store helper.
# Both functions were checked with OPEN-qualified disassembly/CFG, callers, callees, data references,
# adjacent boundaries, source history, current match state, and vendor/FID negative controls.

column6: an optional post-decrement loop repeatedly writes a2 as one 32-bit word to the unchanged a0 address; the counter and store occupy the loop branch schedule
column7: sole caller is OPEN main, passing address 0x800377a0 (the first word of cd_search_file), count 0x70218, and zero; the original startup boundary definition remains unresolved; the exact same 0x24-byte body and source shape occur at the head of GAME.EXE; retail count is exactly (0x801f8000 - startup address) / sizeof(int), reaching stack bottom rather than an independently established BSS end
column8: a0 is stored through as native int *, a1 is a native int count, a2 is stored as a full word, and no result escapes
column9: absent from functions_vendored.tsv and FID inventories; no match in freshly rebuilt Release 2.5 general (1226) and H2000 (179) SDK signatures or complete-body scan of 266 media files; the non-advancing store differs from SDK startup and BIOS clear stubs, but original source provenance remains unresolved (startup-sdk-provenance.md)
column11: void repeat_store_word(int *destination, int count, int value)
column12: supported behavioral identity shared with the byte-identical GAME helper; signature and non-advancing repeated store are exact; broader startup purpose remains unresolved

column6: one straight-line entry calls the compiler __main hook, repeatedly zeroes the single word at raw address 0x800377a0 through the non-advancing adjacent helper, initializes CD and heap state, exits the critical section, then calls the opening controller with entry_args[0]
column7: start tail-jumps here; startup uses lui/ori for 0x800377a0 and 0x80080100, and 0x177f00 is the difference from the shared 0x801f8000 heap endpoint; candidate address references are now recorded, while original relocation records and source definitions are unavailable; startup-address-origins.md
column8: a1 is retained as a u32 pointer and dereferenced for the controller argument; a0 is not consumed by the explicit body, and no result escapes
column9: absent from functions_vendored.tsv and FID inventories; __main, CdInit, InitHeap, and ExitCriticalSection are separately identified provider calls while the surrounding policy is program-owned
column12: source retains symbolic BSS_START/BSS_END and RAM/stack-derived sizes; retail call order and non-advancing helper preserved; native linker boundary labels contain no code or storage; original boundary spelling and constant-folding mechanism remain unresolved (startup-address-origins.md)
